content: If BonBon were made by a big company instead of by an aging hippie software developer working with his super-powerful friend Claude, we would have gone on a press tour, probably via Zoom, of all the major pubs to prepare them for a fundamental change in what we think of as the web. We would have produced a huge example site, and worked with leading content publishers like the NYT, Kottke and Heather Cox Richardson to get their work BonBon-ready. We would have a developer conference where web devs and political leaders would speak about the importance of writing on the web. I would have contacted Tim Berners-Lee and asked him to write the preface for the docs, telling about his vision now, over 30 years since the inception of the web, and what he thinks of the future. Then I would speak, and say enough of that, here's a demo, and then I would give you the URL of the download page, and ask you to keep an open mind to what's possible. If you do, imho, you will be rewarded. But I won't be doing any of that. Instead I asked ChatGPT to explain BonBon from a historic perspective, based on a conversation we had yesterday. And later today or tomorrow I will link to the download site from my blog home page, and encourage you to find out what having a new web Writer's Web might mean to you. Till then, your friend, web writer and reader, Dave Winer. ;-)
